items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Your uncle too. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, you see he, Uncle John he used to be away from home so much...

ctx.x: Maybe if we got out there someday we could interview them, you know, for Tulane 2. Yeah, yeah. Get a little bit of back. Yeah, I guess they have it. Your uncle too.

Yeah, you see he, Uncle John he used to be away from home so much because a lot of times he had this, Larry's Theater, he used to stay in there a lot of times all night writing music. He used to be writing music all the time and the shows used to come in there without music and he used to write music for them and he'd write music for different people, for different bands and all that, and he was always writing. And he, I think he stayed up quite a bit writing in those shows he used to have to play a matinee every…
He'd stay up all night and copy that music for the next day.
